new_evidence_axis.rule: For saturated (gate_shape, data_source) cells, legal override axes are limited to a new data source, a new gate shape, or materially more closed/settled forward rows. Same-source new fields/tags do not qualify.

reopen_condition_guard.rule: If a parked surface has a quantitative reopen_condition, alpha-lane reservations that target that surface are blocked until the numeric reopen checks pass, unless the ticket names a genuinely new data source or a new gate shape.

routine_materialization_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 routine delta materialization: after 3 routine forward-ledger materialization IDs (one surface, or same-shape across surfaces within 7 days), wire the materialization into run.py / the settlement pipeline once instead of reserving further manual IDs. Fault recovery is exempt.

saturated_source_axis.rule: For saturated (gate_shape, data_source) cells, legal override axes are limited to a new data source, a new gate shape, or materially more closed/settled forward rows. Same-source new fields/tags do not qualify.

prediction.confidence_reason: Post-capitulation short-horizon index rebound is a documented crisis-alpha pattern; unconditional single-name reversal died in-repo (exp-20260606-003/20260607-005) but episode-conditioned ETF-level was never tested; backfilled history raises episode n from 3 to roughly 8-10.

calibration.surprise_note: Predicted 0.4 success; realized rejection matched the top predeclared failure mode. The surprise was magnitude and mechanism: episode duration, not entry quality, drives the loss - long bears convert one trigger into 50-124 sequential re-entries, so per-trade edge is dominated by episode-length exposure. Any retry must budget entries per episode or condition on bear-vs-correction state, which is a different gate shape.
